research_question: How predictive is one IRL major weekend of the next same-format IRL major weekend, and does that relationship decay with elapsed time?

evidence.pair_definition: Adjacent cohorts within identical display_format; no skipping intervening cohorts

archetype_retention.model: pair-fixed-effect target_share ~ prior_share + prior_share*gap; gap centered at median
archetype_retention.warning: Descriptive compositional sensitivity; rows within a pair are not independent. Pair fixed effects and format-cluster bootstrap mitigate but do not eliminate compositional dependence.

composition_preserving_models_full_sampl.warning: In-sample fits only; use holdout/walk-forward for predictive conclusions.

interpretation_boundary: IRL-to-IRL regression measures persistence of IRL fields. Its coefficients are not IRL-vs-Online blend weights. Full-sample fits are in-sample; chronological holdout/walk-forward are the stronger prediction checks.
